title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
主要内容: On March 3, 2020, the Federal Reserve issued a statement following its FOMC meeting. In response to evolving risks from the coronavirus, the Federal Reserve lowered the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point to 1 to 1‑1/4 percent. This decision aims to support achieving maximum employment and price stability goals.
